newsitem.title: POLAND: Citroen Poland issues PLN 15 mln one-month CP's.
newsitem.headline: Citroen Poland issues PLN 15 mln one-month CP's.

text.p: The Polish subsidiary of France's PSA Peugeot-Citroen issued 15 million zlotys worth of one-month commercial paper at a yield of 18.95 percent, the issue's buyer, Societe Generale in Warsaw, said on Tuesday.
The bank will now sell the paper on the secondary market.
The notes were a part of Citroen Poland's two-year zloty issue programme, which is guaranteed by Citroen Automobile France, a dealer at Societe Generale in Warsaw said.
The value date for the issue is October 31, and the paper matures on December 2, 1996. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
